raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since batch 12, some rows come from an undocumented new 'v2' collector, and its txn_ts values appear to be 6 hours ahead of the legacy local timestamps. The 6-hour figure is inferred, not confirmed: v2 samples start at 12:00 while legacy samples start at 06:00, and the shift fits evening transactions spilling into 00:00-06:00 the next day, including the 31 rows dated 2026-01-19. The fix converts v2 timestamps back to the legacy local time before deriving txn_ts and txn_date; the offset should still be confirmed with the source team.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
